name: cwe_validation
description: CWE relevance validation for security controls - Brandon Bailey persona

cases.control_text: The system shall validate all command inputs before processing, ensuring that buffer lengths do not exceed allocated memory. All telemetry packets must be bounds-checked before parsing.
cases.notes: Memory safety and input validation - no SQL or auth involved

cases.control_text: Ground station operators must authenticate using multi-factor authentication before accessing satellite command interfaces. Default passwords shall be changed upon first use.
cases.notes: Authentication controls - no memory or SQL operations

cases.control_text: All communications between spacecraft and ground station shall use AES-256 encryption. Encryption keys must be rotated every 90 days using secure key exchange protocols.
cases.notes: Cryptography controls - specifically encryption and key management

cases.control_text: Firmware updates shall be cryptographically signed and verified before installation. The spacecraft shall detect and reject corrupted or tampered firmware images. Telemetry data integrity shall be verified using checksums.
cases.notes: Space systems - firmware verification, telemetry integrity

cases.control_text: The spacecraft control system shall limit the number of concurrent command sessions to prevent resource exhaustion. Memory allocation for command buffers shall be monitored and freed after use.
cases.notes: Resource management - DoS prevention, memory leaks

cases.control_text: Users shall only access satellite subsystems for which they have explicit authorization. Privilege escalation from operator to administrator roles requires additional approval.
The ground system shall sanitize all operator-provided commands to prevent injection attacks. File paths in upload commands shall be validated to prevent directory traversal.
cases.notes: Input validation - command injection and path traversal (no web context so no XSS)

cases.control_text: The spacecraft memory management system shall prevent use-after-free conditions and null pointer dereferences. Integer overflow checks shall be performed on all arithmetic operations involving sensor data.
cases.notes: Memory safety - use-after-free, null pointer, integer overflow

cases.control_text: The satellite shall implement radiation-hardened memory with error detection and correction. Single Event Upsets (SEUs) shall be detected and logged for ground station review.
cases.notes: Space systems - radiation effects and firmware integrity

cases.control_text: The flight software shall store passwords in hashed format using approved algorithms. Credential transmission shall occur only over encrypted channels.
cases.notes: Authentication + Cryptography - password storage and credential protection
